title: Docs: bring the Survey notebook on main up to date again (to ad935b8df; the baseline and 6 Nov readings), those paths only
description:
## Goal

Main carries the Survey notebook up to the baseline experiment and the independent readings of 6 November, so that the paper's v2 (LIN-4331) and the essay (LIN-4330) can cite them at main.

## Context

LIN-4314 synced the notebook to branch commit `98670be3`, and main's `docs/plans/survey/log.md` ends at 6 Nov 08:15. Since then the branch has added:

* the baseline for the area reads (`place-ledger.md`, "Next 2: a baseline for the area reads"; `log.md` 6 Nov 12:30 and 13:10);
* the readings of Seams run 9 and Drift run 5;
* John's notes on the paper's balance and on structure;
* the notes' "At the pause" section.

Both Surveys of LIN-4330 found that the essay's strongest evidence is not citable at main.

## This step

Copy `docs/plans/survey.md` and everything under `docs/plans/survey/` from `origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j` **at** `6db55dcd`, unchanged and only those paths, with `git checkout 6db55dcd -- <paths>` or the equivalent. Do not merge or cherry-pick the branch, which carries unrelated, unmerged code.

The diff from main to `6db55dcd` on these paths was checked beforehand: three files changed (`log.md`, `notes-2026-11-05.md`, `place-ledger.md`), 228 lines added and 1 removed (a line in the notes replaced on the branch). `docs/plans/survey.md` already matches main, because the branch took the paper's pointer edit back. The anchor resolver already excludes `docs/plans/survey` (LIN-4314).

## Done when

* `git diff 6db55dcd HEAD -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is empty on main after the merge.
* No other path changed.
* The unit suite is green.

## How to go about it (from a Survey before work began)

Both Surveys (on this ticket, 12:38–12:39 comment time, at `afe9074fd`) found the copy straightforward: a scratch checkout passes the unit suite (23,947), `secret-scan` and `scan:public-pages`. The person's scope call:

1. **The pin moves to** `ad935b8df` (from `6db55dcd`). Since filing, the branch corrected its own baseline claim, which now reads narrower, and added a note that the notebook's clock headings drift from git and comment times. That is the version the paper and essay should cite. The diff from main to `ad935b8df` on these paths is 242 added lines and 1 replaced line, all made on the branch.
2. **Land it alone, first.** It merges before any LIN-4331 or LIN-4330 PR touches `docs/plans/survey*`. Run the Done-when diff immediately after the merge.
3. **The PR body records both shas,** the branch commit copied (`ad935b8df`) and the main commit synced against, so the next sync starts from a known pair.
4. **Copy unchanged.** That includes the operator working state in `notes-2026-11-05.md` (a token's *filename* and expiry, a trigger id, scratchpad paths). No secret values; check once for anything credential-shaped, as the Survey suggests. Moving that state off main is a working-practice decision for later, not this copy.

**Done when (revised):** `git diff ad935b8df HEAD -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is empty on main right after the merge; no other path changed; the unit suite is green.

comments.body:
## Survey global: LIN-4332 @ afe9074fd

Read at LinearViewer `afe9074fd` (origin/main, 6 Nov 12:09). I read only main. I did not open `6db55dcd`, so the diff counts below are the ticket's own.

**Where it lands.** In `docs/plans/survey.md` and `docs/plans/survey/` (12 files, about 3,300 lines; `log.md` alone is 2,399). This is a dated research notebook. Its source of truth is a long-lived branch, and main holds a copy that gets re-synced by path. This is the third sync (LIN-4248, LIN-4314, now this one). The place around it is in good shape for this kind of change:
- `DENYLIST_DIRS` in `tests/unit/docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js:94` exempts the notebook, so stale `CLAUDE.md:NN` citations in new log entries won't fail the suite.
- The link guard only walks `docs/architecture/`.
- `tests/unit/lin-4248-survey-stages.test.js:134` pins only that `survey.md` and `notes-2026-11-05.md` are non-empty, plus the template pointers in `prompt.md` and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md`. Neither file is in this diff.
- The paper pins its notebook citations to a sha (`place-ledger.md@1d10f9b3:106`, `log.md@1d10f9b3:22`). Adding 228 lines and replacing one can't move a line it cites.

It's getting better: LIN-4314's exemption and LIN-4315's sha pins are what let a sync be a plain path checkout.

**Done the obvious way.** The task adds text and leaves nothing without a home. No list or catalog indexes the notebook's files (`library-doc-summaries.json` covers papers only), so nothing else needs to learn about the change, and nothing would notice if it were skipped. Two things to watch:
1. **Copies.** After the merge there are three copies of the ledger: the branch, main, and the paper's frozen `.snapshot`. The snapshot is intentional and pinned. The branch-to-main pair is the real two-writer case, and the ticket shows it: `survey.md` "already matches main, because the branch took the paper's pointer edit back". Edits now flow in both directions by hand. Nothing checks that main's copy is a prefix of the branch's, only the `git diff` in the Done-when.
2. **Session state on main.** `notes-2026-11-05.md` already holds operator working state, such as the `.tok4` filename and its expiry, a trigger id, scratchpad script paths and "How to resume (for Claude)". There's no secret value, but "At the pause" probably adds more of the same. It's a session's memory published as a doc. The builder should read the new section once for anything token- or credential-shaped before it lands.

**Better, at this task's cost.** Make the PR body record the branch sha and the main sha it synced against, as LIN-4314's commit did, so the next sync starts from a known pair. Also check the one replaced line in the notes: if it is the "Sync this branch's `docs/plans/survey/` to main through a docs ticket" note, it should read true at main after the merge.

**Better still, not this task's.** The ticket treats a symptom. The notebook is written on a branch that carries unmerged code, so each time a paper or essay needs to cite it, someone files a sync ticket. Writing the notebook on main, or on a docs-only branch merged at each milestone, would end the sync tickets and the two-way edits. That is a working-practice decision for John, not a docs change.

## Survey open-0: LIN-4332 @ afe9074fd

**The copy itself is easy.** I applied the checkout in a scratch worktree at `afe9074fd`, ran the checks, then reset it.
- The diff is what the ticket says: `log.md` +177, `notes-2026-11-05.md` +31/−1, `place-ledger.md` +21. `survey.md` is identical. No other path is touched.
- `npm run test:unit`: 23,947 pass, 0 fail. `secret-scan` and `scan:public-pages` are clean.
- `docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js:94` denylists `docs/plans/survey`, as stated. `lin-4248-survey-stages.test.js:134` only needs `survey.md` and the notes to be non-empty. Nothing in the suite reads the notebook's contents.

The difficulty is in what the PR is for.

**1. This is a symptom: the notebook lives on a code branch.** This is the second sync in about a day (LIN-4314 went to `98670be3`). There have been 30 branch commits on these paths since then, roughly one per half hour. Drift also runs both ways: LIN-4315 edited `survey.md` on main (`5c63aa26`), and the branch had to take that back. LIN-4331, which this ticket unblocks, is a paper, so it will probably edit the `survey.md` pointer again. A third sync will follow. The fix is to write the notebook on main (small docs-only PRs) or on a docs-only branch. That's outside this ticket, but worth raising.

**2. "Done when" is fragile with respect to ordering.** `git diff 6db55dcd HEAD -- <paths>` is empty only if nothing else touches these paths between this merge and the check. Merge this before any LIN-4331 or LIN-4330 PR lands, and run the check right after the merge, not when LIN-4331 closes.

**3. Synced doesn't mean the evidence can be cited.** The new prose names 29 short hashes. At `afe9074fd`:
- 21 resolve on main.
- 1 is branch-only: `98670be3`, the LIN-4314 sync point.
- 7 resolve nowhere in this repo (e.g. `3cf6cd76`, `dab3abb3`). In context ("Started (`…`)", mints) they're probably dispatch ids, not commits.

The underlying data is also missing from the repo. The baseline's blind reads, Seams run 9 and Drift run 5 live as Linear comments. LIN-4315 handled this by freezing its evidence under `docs/papers/harbour/cleaner-than-it-started-evidence/`. After this sync, main will carry the log's account of the 6 Nov readings but not the readings. If the essay's strongest claim is "1 of 4 vs 7 of 7", then citable at main probably means a frozen evidence pack for LIN-4331, not this copy. The copy is necessary, but not sufficient.

**4. Small content points the reviewer will see.**
- "At the pause" puts operational detail on main: the `.tok4` expiry and a queue of ticket ids. It isn't a secret, and the scans pass.
- The one replaced line points at `scratchpad/periodical.sh`, which isn't tracked in the repo.

Both are faithful to the branch; the ticket says "unchanged", so leave them.

**What I'd do first:** confirm with LIN-4331's owner that the paper will cite the frozen readings (or the Linear comments), not only `log.md`. Then land this copy alone, before any other PR touching `docs/plans/survey*`, and run the "Done when" diff immediately after the merge.

## Implementation: LIN-4332 @ afe9074fd

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2336 (branch `feat/lin-4332-survey-notebook-sync`, commit `675b3c5b`)

**Synced:** `docs/plans/survey.md` and `docs/plans/survey/` by path checkout from branch SHA **`ad935b8df`** (not `6db55dcd`, which the revised ticket supersedes), against main **`afe9074fd7173e184d83de1fcb4ad3b3290f71fa`**. 3 files, +242/−1. Nothing else changed. No merge or cherry-pick.

**Done when:**
- `git diff ad935b8df HEAD -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is empty (0 lines) on the branch commit. Re-run it right after merge.
- No other path changed.
- Unit suite: 23,947 pass, 0 fail.

**CI (exists, all green):** Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source), CI success. `mergeStateStatus` CLEAN.

**Local checks:** `secret-scan` PASS (5974 files, 0 secrets). `scan:public-pages` clean (13 pages). Credential-shape grep over the added lines: no hits. `notes-2026-11-05.md` left unchanged.

**Not in this PR:** whether the essay's strongest readings can be cited at main depends on the frozen evidence (they live in Linear comments), so that is for LIN-4331 to settle. Merge is for the orchestrator or a human after review.

## Review — LIN-4332

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2336 at head `675b3c5bbd1123e547dead2e520bd28a0674f251`. The parent is `afe9074fd` and `origin/main` is still there.

CI: green on `675b3c5b` (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source), CI success). `mergeStateStatus` CLEAN.

**Scope against the revised plan.** I checked each point myself:
- **Pin.** The pin is `ad935b8df`, the revised one, not the `6db55dcd` in the title. `ad935b8df` is an ancestor of `origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`.
- **Done-when diff.** `git diff ad935b8df 675b3c5b -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is 0 lines.
- **No other path.** `git diff --stat afe9074fd 675b3c5b` shows only `log.md` +191, `notes-2026-11-05.md` +30/−1 and `place-ledger.md` +21, which is 242/1 as the ticket says. It is a single commit whose only parent is main, so there was no merge or cherry-pick.
- **Both shas in the PR body.** The branch sha copied (`ad935b8df`) and the main sha synced against (`afe9074fd…`) are both recorded.
- **Copied unchanged.** The one replaced line is the branch's own rewrite of the `**Periodicals:**` bullet in the notes. It is not the "sync through a docs ticket" note that the Survey asked about. It now names `scratchpad/periodical.sh`, which is not tracked in the repo. That is faithful to the branch and stays as it is.

**Regression check.** Main's history on these paths is `29f14bf6` (LIN-4248), `1d10f9b3` (LIN-4314) and `5c63aa26` (LIN-4315). LIN-4315 made the one edit on main that was not on the branch: the "Where it stands" pointer in `survey.md`. That edit survives, because `survey.md` is not in this diff and is already the same at the pin. Nothing that was reverted comes back. No commits have touched these paths on main since the ticket was created.

**Credential check (once, as asked).** I grepped the added lines for token, key and password shapes. There are no values. The only session state is the `.tok4` filename and its expiry, the Periodicals route and the scratchpad script paths. These are the same kinds the ticket already accepted.

**Tests.** None were added, and that is right: this is a docs copy, and the suite does not read the notebook's content. `lin-4248-survey-stages.test.js` only needs the files to be non-empty. Mutation-checking does not apply here; the done-when diff is the witness.

**One of a class?** No. It is the third instance of a recurring manual sync (LIN-4248, LIN-4314, now this one). The class cause is that the notebook is written on a code branch. Both Surveys named that cause, and the ticket explicitly left it as John's working-practice decision. It is outside this ticket's bounded scope, and I am not raising it as a ruling because it is not this ticket's to settle.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside (the ticket's own Done-when).** After the merge, the diff `git diff ad935b8df origin/main -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` must be empty on main. CI ran on the PR branch, not on the merged main.
  - Settle it **after the merge**: close-out runs it straight after merging and before anything else lands on `docs/plans/survey*`. Any output means the check fails.
  - Ordering precondition: right now no other open PR touches `docs/plans/survey*`. Only #2336 does. Close-out should re-check that list just before merging. If a LIN-4331 or LIN-4330 PR has appeared, merge #2336 first.
- **Inside (a claim the change depends on, the pin).** `ad935b8df` is the version the paper and essay should cite. The branch has moved on by one commit on these paths, `81d082cb` ("Survey log: LIN-4332 started at ad935b8d…"). That commit was deliberately left out, since the ticket pins `ad935b8df`. Nothing more is needed; this is recorded so that the next sync starts from `ad935b8df` → `81d082cb`.
- **Outside (owned by LIN-4331 / LIN-4330).** The goal says the readings can then be cited at main. But the baseline's blind reads, Seams run 9 and Drift run 5 are Linear comments, and main gets only the log's account of them. Seven short hashes in the new prose resolve nowhere in the repo, and they are probably dispatch ids.
  - This is not a defect in this copy, and the ticket's revised Done-when does not depend on it.
  - LIN-4331 already holds it, so close-out should check there rather than file a new ticket.

**Fix for close-out (cosmetic).** Change the ticket title's pin from "to 6db55dcd" to "to ad935b8df", so the title matches the revised Done-when and the PR.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger.

The copy is exact, limited to the right paths and pinned to the revised sha, and CI is green. All that remains is to run the post-merge Done-when diff in the right order.

## Close-out — LIN-4332

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2336, squash-merged as `1c894016b902314df18be2ee06e37c3c8041a079`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 675b3c5b` (the commit CI passed on). Parent is `afe9074fd`. Before merging I re-checked that no other open PR touches `docs/plans/survey*` (only #2336 did) and that main was still at `afe9074fd`.

**Fixes made after review:** none were asked for. Review's only request was cosmetic: change the ticket title's pin to `ad935b8df`. Done on the ticket itself (no commit; nothing in the repo changed).

**CI:** green on `675b3c5b` (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source), CI success; `mergeStateStatus` CLEAN). The merge commit's tree `8dcd5582…` is identical to the PR head's tree, so those results apply to it. The run on main (actions run 42221586299) was still in progress when I closed. Its Secret scan had passed; Unit tests and E2E shards had not finished. I did not wait for them.

**Ledger**
- **Inside, post-merge Done-when diff — settled.** I ran the check right after the merge, before anything else could land. I had no checkout, so instead of `git diff ad935b8df HEAD -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` I compared the git tree entries (blob SHAs) for those paths at `ad935b8df` and at `1c894016`. Both have 14 entries and the diff is empty, which is equivalent to an empty `git diff`. The merge commit changes only `log.md`, `notes-2026-11-05.md` and `place-ledger.md`, so no other path changed.
- **Inside, the pin — settled.** Copied from `ad935b8df`, not `6db55dcd`. The next sync starts from `ad935b8df` → `81d082cb`, as review recorded.
- **Outside, readings citable at main — not filed.** LIN-4331 already holds it: it asks to freeze the eight baseline comments, recount the area tally from the comments, and re-implement the selection rule. I linked LIN-4332 ↔ LIN-4331 as `related`. The seven unresolved short hashes (probably dispatch ids) are a point for that paper's author.
- **Named monitor or rollback:** review named none, so none is claimed.

**Deploy:** this is a docs-only change with no deploy step, so there were no post-deploy steps.

**Description:** I did not archive or prune it. It has no implementation-plan, research or scoping sections to discharge, only the goal, context, scope and Done-when, which are kept.

**Not done, for the operator:** the recurring cause (the notebook is written on a code branch, so each citation needs a sync ticket) is John's working-practice decision. It is not filed as a ticket.

## Close-out addendum — LIN-4332

CI on main for merge commit `1c894016` has finished green: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source), CI success (actions run 42221586299). This replaces the "in progress" note in the close-out comment.
